cues.en: In the previous video, I talked about the importance of accountability in self directed learning and the challenges that come with accountability in self directed learning.
cues.zh: 上一支影片，我談到自主學習中，對學習負責的重要性，以及隨之而來的挑戰。

cues.en: And now in this video, I'm going to give you a few suggestions.
cues.zh: 現在這支影片，我要給你幾個建議。

cues.en: These are just a few fun ideas that I have used in the past.
cues.zh: 這些只是我過去用過、幾個有趣的想法。

cues.en: And after watching this video, if you have some other tips or suggestions, feel free to post them in the Q&A.
cues.zh: 看完後，如果你有其他技巧或建議，歡迎貼到問答區。

cues.en: Maybe that will help out other students who would appreciate those extra tips.
cues.zh: 也許能幫到其他學員，他們會很感謝這些額外的技巧。

cues.en: Now, first of all, some general strategies.
cues.zh: 首先，一些一般策略。

cues.en: Before getting to the specific tips, you have to break down your big learning goals into smaller, more manageable sub goals.
cues.zh: 在講具體技巧之前，你必須把大的學習目標，拆成更小、更容易掌握的子目標。

cues.en: So you want to learn calculus from this course.
cues.zh: 所以你想透過這門課學微積分。

cues.en: Well, that's a great goal, but that's a big goal.
cues.zh: 很棒，但這是個大目標。

cues.en: You have to break it down into sub goals.
cues.zh: 需要拆成子目標。

cues.en: For example, maybe two videos per day.
cues.zh: 例如，每天看兩支影片。

cues.en: That's just an example.
cues.zh: 這只是個例子。

cues.en: Everyone has to set their own sub goals depending on their own schedule and their own needs.
cues.zh: 每個人都得根據自己的行程與需求，設定子目標。

cues.en: Now you need to set deadlines and these need to be realistic deadlines that are defined for each sub goal.
cues.zh: 接著需要設定期限，針對每個子目標，設定實際可行的期限。

cues.en: And I really want to stress that these need to be realistic deadlines because the accountability measures will have real consequences and then you can't just have deadlines.
cues.zh: 我真的想強調，期限必須實際可行，因為督促自己履行責任的措施，會有真實後果。而且不能只有期限。

cues.en: So there needs to be consequences of what happens when you meet a deadline or you miss a deadline.
cues.zh: 達成期限，或錯過期限時，都需要有相應的結果。

cues.en: I'll talk about this more on the next slide.
cues.zh: 下一張投影片會再多談。

cues.en: And you also need to hold yourself accountable.
cues.zh: 你也必須要求自己負責。

cues.en: You need to follow through with your consequences.
cues.zh: 確實執行自己訂下的後果。

cues.en: And if possible, it's really helpful and also fun to have an accountability buddy.
cues.zh: 如果可能，有個互相督促的夥伴，會很有幫助，也很有趣。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So let me show you a few specific examples.
cues.zh: 我來示範幾個具體例子。

cues.en: First example by some chocolate, now I don't mean a candy bar from the gas station.
cues.zh: 第一個，買巧克力。我不是說加油站買的巧克力棒。

cues.en: I mean, spend like €20 on a really nice box of luxury chocolates, and then you give that box of chocolates to your accountability buddy.
cues.zh: 我是說花大約 20 歐元，買一盒很棒的高級巧克力，再交給督促你的夥伴。

cues.en: Now, if you meet your deadline, then they give it back to you and you can enjoy your treat.
cues.zh: 如果你如期完成，他就把巧克力還你，你就能享受獎勵。

cues.en: Maybe even you choose to share with your accountability, buddy, but at least you get to enjoy the chocolate.
cues.zh: 也許你會選擇和夥伴分享，但至少能享用巧克力。

cues.en: And if you miss the deadline, you have to throw away the chocolate.
cues.zh: 如果錯過期限，就必須把巧克力丟掉。

cues.en: And this is important.
cues.zh: 這很重要。

cues.en: You're not allowed to give away the chocolate to someone else as a gift because that's still a nice thing to do and someone enjoys it.
cues.zh: 不能把巧克力當禮物送給別人，因為那仍然是件好事，仍然有人能享用。

cues.en: You really have to throw it in the trash.
cues.zh: 真的要丟進垃圾桶。

cues.en: That's terrible, isn't it?
cues.zh: 很糟糕，對吧？

cues.en: It's such a waste of good, expensive chocolate.
cues.zh: 浪費了那麼好、那麼貴的巧克力。

cues.en: It's a waste of money.
cues.zh: 也浪費錢。

cues.en: Nobody benefits from this.
cues.zh: 沒有人受益。

cues.en: It's a total loss and a total waste.
cues.zh: 完全是損失、完全是浪費。

cues.en: But that is exactly the point.
cues.zh: 但這正是重點。

cues.en: The point is that there are real consequences for missing your deadline.
cues.zh: 錯過期限，真的會有後果。

cues.en: So you can see why it's important to set realistic deadlines.
cues.zh: 所以你看得出，為什麼設定實際可行的期限很重要。

cues.en: So I'm going to show a few more specific suggestions like this.
cues.zh: 我會再給幾個類似的具體建議。

cues.en: But the general point is that there needs to be real consequences for meeting your deadlines, for holding yourself accountable.
cues.zh: 但大致重點是，能否如期完成、能否對自己負責，必須有真實後果。

cues.en: But on the other hand, they shouldn't be like really severe, lifelong, dangerous consequences.
cues.zh: 不過另一方面，不應該是非常嚴重、影響一輩子或危險的後果。

cues.en: You don't want to have to cut off your finger just for missing your deadline.
cues.zh: 你不會想只是因為錯過期限，就得剁掉手指。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Next example, same story, same concept.
cues.zh: 下一個例子，同樣的故事、同樣的概念。

cues.en: But you give your accountability, buddy.
cues.zh: 不過交給督促你的夥伴的，

cues.en: Let's say a t shirt that you really like or maybe a pair of gloves or an earring or something like that.
cues.zh: 可以是你非常喜歡的一件 T 恤，或一副手套、一只耳環之類的。

cues.en: Again, the idea is that it needs to have real consequences, but you don't want to be so severe about it.
cues.zh: 同樣地，想法是需要有真實後果，但別太嚴重。

cues.en: You don't want to have to throw out your only winter coat when you live in northern Canada.
cues.zh: 如果住在加拿大北部，你不會想把唯一的冬季外套丟掉。

cues.en: And again, if you miss your deadline, this thing, your your favorite shirt or your favorite socks or something like that, you really have to throw it in the trash so it goes to the dumpster.
cues.zh: 同樣地，如果錯過期限，就真的得把那個東西，你最愛的襯衫或襪子之類的，丟進垃圾桶。

cues.en: You can't give it away.
cues.zh: 不能送人。

cues.en: You can't give it to charity, or your friend gets to wear it because it has to be a total waste, really a loss.
cues.zh: 不能捐給慈善機構，也不能讓朋友拿去穿，因為必須完全浪費、真正損失。

cues.en: And that is providing strong motivation for you to meet your deadline and accomplish your goals.
cues.zh: 這會提供強烈的動機，讓你如期完成、達成目標。

cues.en: And that is also why, again, I'm repeating myself here, but you want to set realistic sub goals with realistic deadlines that you think that you can really meet.
cues.zh: 所以再次說明，雖然我又重複了，但你要設定實際可行、自己認為真正做得到的子目標與期限。

cues.en: Okay, next one.
cues.zh: 好，下一個。

cues.en: This one I also like.
cues.zh: 這個我也喜歡。

cues.en: Basically you treat yourself to a nice dinner If you meet your deadline or if you miss your deadline, then you have to skip dinner and no snacking instead of dinner.
cues.zh: 基本上，如果如期完成，就請自己吃一頓好晚餐；如果錯過期限，就不能吃晚餐，也不能用零食代替。

cues.en: So, you know, skipping one meal is uncomfortable.
cues.zh: 少吃一餐會不舒服。

cues.en: It's annoying.
cues.zh: 很惱人。

cues.en: You'll be hungry.
cues.zh: 你會餓。

cues.en: So that's a real consequence.
cues.zh: 所以這是真實的後果。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Last one.
cues.zh: 最後一個。

cues.en: This one is about money and, well, I think you're starting to get the idea.
cues.zh: 這個和錢有關，我想你開始懂這個概念了。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Now, to be totally honest, I have done these first three.
cues.zh: 完全坦白說，前三個我都做過。

cues.en: I haven't done this one.
cues.zh: 這個沒做過。

cues.en: And yeah, these ones were all fun points of accountability to do this one.
cues.zh: 這些都是有趣的自我督促方式。這一個，

cues.en: I did it with my favorite gold hoop earring is Little Hoop Earring that I like instead of a shirt, but same concept.
cues.zh: 我用的是最喜歡的金色圈形耳環，一個我喜歡的小圈形耳環，而不是襯衫，但概念相同。

cues.en: And don't worry, I actually got back the earring.
cues.zh: 別擔心，我確實把耳環拿回來了。

cues.en: All right, so that's it.
cues.zh: 好，就是這樣。

cues.en: Just a few fun suggestions.
cues.zh: 只是幾個有趣的建議。

cues.en: If you have other ideas that you think your fellow learners would benefit from, feel free to post to
cues.zh: 如果你有其他想法，覺得對同學有幫助，歡迎貼到

cues.en: the Q&A or just come check out the Q&A and see what other students have written about this video.
cues.zh: 問答區，或去問答區看看其他學員對這支影片寫了什麼。
